bot.title: 1. Discord bot
bot.tokenMissing: The bot token is not set yet. Create it in the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token) and paste it in Setup.
bot.tokenInvalid: Discord rejected the token. Create a new one in the Developer Portal and update it in Setup.
bot.intent: One step is missing in the Developer Portal: in the Bot section, turn on “Message Content Intent” and save. Then press Check again.
bot.connecting: The bot is connecting. Check again in a few seconds.
bot.invite: Invite the bot to a server
bot.inviteHelp: The bot cannot see any channel yet. Invite it to your server, then press Check again.

channels.title: 2. Channels
channels.help: Choose which agent answers in each channel. It answers in a thread, with its own name and avatar, and remembers that thread's conversation.
channels.noVisible: The bot cannot see any channel. Invite it to a server or give it access to the channel in Discord.

form.onEvery: Every new message in the channel
form.noFreeChannels: Every channel the bot can see already has an agent.
form.instructionsExample: E.g.: This is the customer support channel. Answer formally and send billing questions to #admin.
form.instructionsHelp: The agent gets them when each new thread starts. Changes apply to new threads.

problems.noAccess: The bot cannot see this channel. Give it access in Discord (Edit channel → Permissions).
problems.unknownAgent: This agent no longer exists in the project. Choose another one.
problems.permissions: In this channel the bot is missing: {{permissions}}. Grant it in Discord (Edit channel → Permissions).

errors.unreachable: Discord could not be reached. Check again.
errors.rate_limited: Discord asked us to wait. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.missing_access: The bot cannot access this channel.
errors.missing_channel: The channel no longer exists in Discord.
errors.unsupported_channel: Choose a text or announcement channel.
errors.invalid_input: Choose a channel and an agent.
errors.assignment_changed: Someone changed this channel meanwhile. Check again and retry.
errors.unknown_agent: That agent no longer exists in the project.
errors.invalid_config: project/discord.yaml has an error. Fix it to edit channels here.
errors.operation_failed: That did not work. Check again.
